t: This is the School of Art, Architecture and Design, part of London Metropolitan University, in Aldgate. It took its present form in 2012, when two faculties merged, and it is based at the university's Aldgate Campus, in Goulston Street, Calcutta House and the Calcutta Small Annexe. It was long known as The Cass, after Sir John Cass, a merchant, Tory MP and philanthropist. He was also a key figure in the Royal African Company, which was involved in the Atlantic slave trade, and his name was removed from the school in 2020 because of that association.
